long_biography.plain_text:
When Salim Erdem acquired a majority stake in Dutch shipbuilder Moonen in 2009, he moved from transport services into the industry that had long interested him personally. He treated the yard as an operating commitment, working with its management on larger custom projects before the Erdem family sold its shares.

Erdem's maritime outlook was formed in Mersin, where his childhood home overlooked the port. He later studied at Boğaziçi University and learned shipping agency work as an employee before starting his own company. That combination of professional discipline and curiosity also shaped a family scholarship for Tarsus American College students with achievements in sport, art and culture.
